description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2049/54 of 14.12.2017, Panadura D/S Division, and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries modifying specific land parcel details (parcel numbers, title classes, ownership details, and encumbrances) across various districts in Sri Lanka. The content is purely land and property-related, focusing on cadastral mapping, land titles, and property ownership changes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
